subject: Money
title: Dopamine and Shopping
description: A quick win: understand Dopamine and Shopping.

hook.text: Dopamine spikes when you anticipate a purchase, not when you own it. The thrill is in the wanting.

buildup.text: Shopping activates the brain's reward circuit. Browsing, comparing, and choosing all release dopamine.

discovery.text: This is why unboxing feels flat. The neurochemical high peaked before you bought the thing.

twist.text: Online shopping is an infinite dopamine loop. Scroll, desire, click, repeat. The cart is the drug.

climax.text: Retailers design for anticipation, not satisfaction. The craving is more profitable than the product.

punchline.text: You don't buy things. You buy the rush.

quiz.question: When does dopamine peak during shopping?
